description: Defines the JsCollectionOptimizerLazy class which implements asset optimization for JavaScript assets within Drupal, including grouping, URL generation, and cleanup.

classes.name: JsCollectionOptimizerLazy
classes.description: A class that optimizes JavaScript asset collections in Drupal, handling grouping, URL generation, deletion, and minification.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies such as asset grouper, optimizer, theme manager, dependency resolver, request stack, file system, config factory, URL generator, time, and language manager.

methods.name: optimize
methods.description: Groups JS assets, generates URLs with query parameters, and prepares assets for delivery, handling different asset types and preprocessed assets.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes old JS files from the assets directory based on a threshold to clean up cache.

methods.name: optimizeGroup
methods.description: Concatenates and minifies a group of JS assets, including license comments and ensuring proper termination.
